name: 2024 Panel income targets, commission rules and multi-job model

attribution.legal_posture: UN Panel reporting; some claims reproduce Member State information and remain outside criminal adjudication.

caveats: The differing revenue figures remain separate; a precise universal rule requires source harmonization.
These are Member State/former-worker estimates and may reflect different periods, teams or gross-versus-net accounting than S/2019/691 and S/2020/151.

statements: A Member State reported overseas IT-worker earnings of $15,000-$60,000 monthly; a former worker reported an annual expectation of at least $100,000, often through multiple full-time positions plus freelance jobs.

Former workers reported retaining only a small percentage: approximately 10% for lower earners up to 30% for the highest earners, with dispatching agencies taking the rest and sometimes using it to purchase goods for the DPRK.
A former worker estimated 3,000 workers overseas and 1,000 inside the DPRK.

sources.support: Supports monthly/annual targets, multiple jobs, worker commission range, dispatch-agency retention and population estimate
